Queries.Name: mssql_process_status
Queries.Query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) count FROM sys.sysprocesses GROUP BY status
Queries.Description: Counts the number of processes per status

Queries.Name: mssql_process_connections
Queries.Query: SELECT ISNULL(DB_NAME(dbid), 'other') as dbname, COUNT(dbid) as connections FROM sys.sysprocesses WHERE dbid > 0 GROUP BY dbid
Queries.Description: Counts the number of connections per db

Queries.Name: mssql_deadlocks
Queries.Query: SELECT cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters where counter_name = 'Number of Deadlocks/sec' AND instance_name = '_Total'
Queries.Description: Number of lock requests per second that resulted in a deadlock since last restart

Queries.Name: mssql_blocking
Queries.Query: ;WITH b AS ( SELECT r.session_id, r.blocking_session_id, r.wait_time, r.wait_type, r.database_id FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id WHERE r.blocking_session_id <> 0 AND s.is_user_process = 1), heads AS (SELECT DISTINCT blocking_session_id AS spid FROM b WHERE blocking_session_id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM b)), chain AS (SELECT session_id, blocking_session_id, 1 AS depth FROM b WHERE blocking_session_id IN (SELECT spid FROM heads) UNION ALL SELECT b.session_id, b.blocking_session_id, c.depth + 1 FROM b JOIN chain c ON b.blocking_session_id = c.session_id WHERE c.depth < 32) SELECT ISNULL(MAX(b.wait_time) / 1000.0, 0) AS max_wait_seconds, COUNT(*) AS blocked_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT b.blocking_session_id) AS blockers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM heads) AS head_blockers, ISNULL(SUM(b.wait_time) / 1000.0, 0) AS total_wait_seconds, ISNULL((SELECT MAX(depth) FROM chain), 0) AS chain_depth_max, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM heads h JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions hs ON hs.session_id = h.spid   WHERE hs.status = 'sleeping' AND hs.open_transaction_count > 0) AS idle_tran_head_blockers, ISNULL((SELECT MAX(DATEDIFF(SECOND, hs.last_request_end_time, GETDATE())) FROM heads h JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions hs ON hs.session_id = h.spid   WHERE hs.status = 'sleeping' AND hs.open_transaction_count > 0), 0) AS idle_tran_head_blocker_max_idle_seconds FROM b
Queries.Description: Current blocking chain snapshot from sys.dm_exec_requests (user requests only)

Queries.Name: mssql_blocking_by_wait_type
Queries.Query: ;WITH b AS ( SELECT r.session_id, r.blocking_session_id, r.wait_time, r.wait_type, r.database_id FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id WHERE r.blocking_session_id <> 0 AND s.is_user_process = 1), heads AS (SELECT DISTINCT blocking_session_id AS spid FROM b WHERE blocking_session_id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM b)) SELECT ISNULL(wait_type, '') AS wait_type, COUNT(*) AS blocked FROM b GROUP BY wait_type
Queries.Description: Blocked user requests per wait type (LCK_M_U, LCK_M_X, LCK_M_S ...)

Queries.Name: mssql_blocking_by_database
Queries.Query: ;WITH b AS ( SELECT r.session_id, r.blocking_session_id, r.wait_time, r.wait_type, r.database_id FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id WHERE r.blocking_session_id <> 0 AND s.is_user_process = 1), heads AS (SELECT DISTINCT blocking_session_id AS spid FROM b WHERE blocking_session_id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM b)) SELECT ISNULL(DB_NAME(database_id), '') AS dbname, COUNT(*) AS blocked FROM b GROUP BY database_id

Queries.Name: mssql_blocking_wait_by_object
Queries.Query: SELECT dbname, resource_type, object_name, COUNT(*) AS waiting FROM ( SELECT ISNULL(DB_NAME(l.resource_database_id), '') AS dbname, l.resource_type,  CASE l.resource_type WHEN 'OBJECT' THEN ISNULL(OBJECT_NAME(l.resource_associated_entity_id, l.resource_database_id), '')   ELSE ISNULL(OBJECT_NAME(p.object_id, l.resource_database_id), '') END AS object_name FROM sys.dm_tran_locks l LEFT JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.hobt_id = l.resource_associated_entity_id  AND l.resource_type IN ('KEY', 'PAGE', 'RID') AND l.resource_database_id = DB_ID() WHERE l.request_status = 'WAIT' AND l.resource_type IN ('OBJECT', 'KEY', 'PAGE', 'RID')) x GROUP BY dbname, resource_type, object_name
Queries.Description: Lock waits per contended object (table name resolvable only for the connection's Initial Catalog; other DBs show empty object)

Queries.Name: mssql_blocking_head_blocker_victims
Queries.Query: ;WITH b AS ( SELECT r.session_id, r.blocking_session_id, r.wait_time, r.wait_type, r.database_id FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id WHERE r.blocking_session_id <> 0 AND s.is_user_process = 1), heads AS (SELECT DISTINCT blocking_session_id AS spid FROM b WHERE blocking_session_id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM b)) SELECT TOP (10) h.spid, RTRIM(ISNULL(hs.host_name, '')) AS host, ISNULL(hs.login_name, '') AS login, ISNULL(hs.program_name, '') AS program, ISNULL(hs.status, '') AS status, ISNULL(DB_NAME(hs.database_id), '') AS dbname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b WHERE b.blocking_session_id = h.spid) AS victims FROM heads h JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions hs ON hs.session_id = h.spid LEFT JOIN sys.dm_tran_session_transactions st ON st.session_id = h.spid AND st.is_user_transaction = 1 LEFT JOIN sys.dm_tran_active_transactions at ON at.transaction_id = st.transaction_id ORDER BY victims DESC
Queries.Description: Per head blocker (blocks others, not blocked itself): number of directly blocked sessions. Labels churn with spid; series live only while the blocker exists.

Queries.Name: mssql_blocking_head_blocker_max_wait_seconds
Queries.Query: ;WITH b AS ( SELECT r.session_id, r.blocking_session_id, r.wait_time, r.wait_type, r.database_id FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id WHERE r.blocking_session_id <> 0 AND s.is_user_process = 1), heads AS (SELECT DISTINCT blocking_session_id AS spid FROM b WHERE blocking_session_id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM b)) SELECT TOP (10) h.spid, RTRIM(ISNULL(hs.host_name, '')) AS host, ISNULL(hs.login_name, '') AS login, ISNULL(hs.program_name, '') AS program, ISNULL(hs.status, '') AS status, ISNULL(DB_NAME(hs.database_id), '') AS dbname, ISNULL((SELECT MAX(b.wait_time) / 1000.0 FROM b WHERE b.blocking_session_id = h.spid), 0) AS max_wait_seconds FROM heads h JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions hs ON hs.session_id = h.spid LEFT JOIN sys.dm_tran_session_transactions st ON st.session_id = h.spid AND st.is_user_transaction = 1 LEFT JOIN sys.dm_tran_active_transactions at ON at.transaction_id = st.transaction_id ORDER BY max_wait_seconds DESC
Queries.Description: Per head blocker: longest wait among the sessions it blocks directly

Queries.Name: mssql_blocking_head_blocker_tran_age_seconds
Queries.Query: ;WITH b AS ( SELECT r.session_id, r.blocking_session_id, r.wait_time, r.wait_type, r.database_id FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id WHERE r.blocking_session_id <> 0 AND s.is_user_process = 1), heads AS (SELECT DISTINCT blocking_session_id AS spid FROM b WHERE blocking_session_id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM b)) SELECT TOP (10) h.spid, RTRIM(ISNULL(hs.host_name, '')) AS host, ISNULL(hs.login_name, '') AS login, ISNULL(hs.program_name, '') AS program, ISNULL(hs.status, '') AS status, ISNULL(DB_NAME(hs.database_id), '') AS dbname, ISNULL(DATEDIFF(SECOND, at.transaction_begin_time, GETDATE()), 0) AS tran_age_seconds FROM heads h JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions hs ON hs.session_id = h.spid LEFT JOIN sys.dm_tran_session_transactions st ON st.session_id = h.spid AND st.is_user_transaction = 1 LEFT JOIN sys.dm_tran_active_transactions at ON at.transaction_id = st.transaction_id ORDER BY tran_age_seconds DESC
Queries.Description: Per head blocker: age of its open user transaction (0 = no open transaction)

Queries.Name: mssql_open_tran
Queries.Query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1 AND open_transaction_count > 0) AS open_transactions, ISNULL((SELECT MAX(DATEDIFF(SECOND, at.transaction_begin_time, GETDATE()))   FROM sys.dm_tran_session_transactions st JOIN sys.dm_tran_active_transactions at ON at.transaction_id = st.transaction_id   JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = st.session_id WHERE st.is_user_transaction = 1 AND s.is_user_process = 1), 0) AS oldest_transaction_seconds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1 AND open_transaction_count > 0 AND status = 'sleeping') AS idle_in_transaction_sessions, ISNULL((SELECT MAX(DATEDIFF(SECOND, last_request_end_time, GETDATE())) FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions   WHERE is_user_process = 1 AND open_transaction_count > 0 AND status = 'sleeping'), 0) AS idle_in_transaction_max_seconds
Queries.Description: Open user transactions: count, oldest age, and sessions sleeping with an open transaction (the classic forgot-to-commit blocker before it blocks anyone)

Queries.Name: mssql_lock_waits_total
Queries.Query: SELECT RTRIM(instance_name) AS resource, CAST(cntr_value AS float) AS value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE RTRIM(object_name) LIKE '%:Locks' AND RTRIM(counter_name) = 'Lock Waits/sec'
Queries.Description: Cumulative lock waits since SQL Server start, per lock resource type (rate() for waits/sec)

Queries.Name: mssql_lock_wait_time_ms_total
Queries.Query: SELECT RTRIM(instance_name) AS resource, CAST(cntr_value AS float) AS value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE RTRIM(object_name) LIKE '%:Locks' AND RTRIM(counter_name) = 'Lock Wait Time (ms)'
Queries.Description: Cumulative lock wait time in ms since SQL Server start, per lock resource type (rate(...)/rate(mssql_lock_waits_total) = average wait)

Queries.Name: mssql_lock_timeouts_total
Queries.Query: SELECT RTRIM(instance_name) AS resource, CAST(cntr_value AS float) AS value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE RTRIM(object_name) LIKE '%:Locks' AND RTRIM(counter_name) = 'Lock Timeouts/sec'
Queries.Description: Cumulative lock timeouts since SQL Server start, per lock resource type

Queries.Name: mssql_deadlocks_total
Queries.Query: SELECT RTRIM(instance_name) AS resource, CAST(cntr_value AS float) AS value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE RTRIM(object_name) LIKE '%:Locks' AND RTRIM(counter_name) = 'Number of Deadlocks/sec'
Queries.Description: Cumulative deadlocks since SQL Server start, per lock resource type (increase() for deadlocks in a window)

Queries.Name: mssql_lock_wait_stats_ms_total
Queries.Query: SELECT wait_type, CAST(wait_time_ms AS float) AS value FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type LIKE 'LCK_M_%' AND waiting_tasks_count > 0
Queries.Description: Cumulative wait time per lock wait type from sys.dm_os_wait_stats (which lock mode hurts: LCK_M_U update, LCK_M_X exclusive, LCK_M_S shared ...)

Queries.Name: mssql_lock_wait_stats_tasks_total
Queries.Query: SELECT wait_type, CAST(waiting_tasks_count AS float) AS value FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type LIKE 'LCK_M_%' AND waiting_tasks_count > 0
Queries.Description: Cumulative number of waits per lock wait type from sys.dm_os_wait_stats

Queries.Name: mssql_lock_misc
Queries.Query: SELECT ISNULL((SELECT cntr_value FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters WHERE RTRIM(object_name) LIKE '%:General Statistics' AND RTRIM(counter_name) = 'Processes blocked'), 0) AS processes_blocked, ISNULL((SELECT CAST(value_in_use AS int) FROM sys.configurations WHERE name = 'blocked process threshold (s)'), 0) AS blocked_process_threshold_seconds
Queries.Description: Processes blocked (the same counter windows_exporter reports) and the blocked process threshold setting (0 = blocked process reports disabled)
